title: Noncooperative Game in Multi-controller System under Delayed and Asymmetric Information
summary: We address a noncooperative game problem in multi-controller system under delayed and asymmetric information structure. Under these conditions, the classical separation principle fails as estimation and control design become strongly coupled, complicating the derivation of an explicit Nash equilibrium. To resolve this, we employ a common-private information decomposition approach, effectively decoupling control inputs and state estimation to obtain a closed-form Nash equilibrium.
